verdict.rationale: Linear's rate-limiting docs publish exact per-auth API limits, leaky-bucket refill, complexity limits and rate-limit response headers, so the throttling behavior for API calls is documented. Admin spend limits that reset on a schedule are also documented, but nothing says what happens when a plan's automation (Loops/agent) quota or spend limit is reached. missing for 10: explicit statement of the over-limit outcome (error/hard stop vs. overage charges), plan-level automation/agent usage limits and what happens when exceeded, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits

citations.quote: API key — 2,500 requests per User per 1 hour; OAuth App — 5,000 per User; Unauthenticated — 600 per IP Address
X-RateLimit-Requests-Limit — The maximum number of API requests you're permitted to make per hour.
Admins can also set workspace-wide and per-user spend limits that reset daily, weekly, or monthly.
